verdict.rationale: Sentry has dashboards and rule-based alerts. It also documents a web API for programmatic management of account-level resources and data. However, nothing in the pack says that API covers dashboards or alert rules, and there is no JSON model or Terraform route. That makes support for provisioning them as code only glancing. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for creating dashboards and alert rules, exportable/importable dashboard JSON models, a Terraform provider or other IaC tooling, and evidence of repeatable provisioning workflows.
